integrity: The infinite-family upper and lower bounds are proved analytically. The bundled finite script is a regression check only and is not used to infer the theorem. The regular-octagon special case is already covered by related exact-constant literature and is not claimed as an isolated novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to regular \(4n\)-gonal real Banach planes and determines the scalar skew constant, not the full function \(E[t,X]\). The cases of other regular polygon orders are not asserted.
title: The skew von Neumann–Jordan constant of every regular \(4n\)-gonal plane
